body.name: Width-two transition vertices
body.construction: Let \(E^{?}_{\to,\bar X}=\{e\in E^{?}:e\text{ is directed and }\operatorname{tail}(e),\operatorname{head}(e)\in V\setminus X\}\). Set \(W^{\mathrm{proj}}=\{\sigma,t\}\cup\{u_\beta:\beta\in\mathcal B\}\cup\{u_e:e\in E^{?}_{\to,\bar X}\}\), where \(\sigma\) is the super-source and \(t\) is the sink.
